clean_copy: project/ = git archive of the source commit (no build outputs), plus the package files; the three cores vendored as sources under vendor/: the forgetting core (whole) and the hard-model core as the lean/ folders of their public releases v1.4.0 and v1.2.0, the noise-diagram core as its release package workspace (no public Lean release yet); no object of the development or of the cores was reused; LEAN_PATH = this package's .lake/build/lib/lean and the nine pinned dependency packages only
records_note: Each peak is the cumulative process-tree peak of its replay invocation, hence an upper bound for the module. free_before_bytes = min(Linux MemAvailable, Windows host heartbeat ullAvailPhys). fresh_full_replay = one replay from an empty build directory (no --resume) of every module reachable from the package roots; later_records = any module rebuilt afterwards.
development_oleans_note: each .olean of the development compiled here against the one of the development build /opt/forgetting-natural-rule-lean/project (which linked the precedent cores' prebuilt objects)
